messages:
Ria: ACME wants a per-org header override for demo today: any request with header `X-ACME-PREF: fast` should route to their reserved pool.
Sophie: Quick clarifying q: should this be an allowlist (bypass normal routing) or a priority rule that wins when predicate matches?
Ria: Priority rule only for that org. It must beat the generic /v1/generate path rule but still respect quota enforcement and emergency fallbacks.
Mike: Reminder of the precedence we discussed: emergency fallback > org emergency flags > org header overrides > path rules > model fallback. Are we changing that order?
Sophie: We shouldn't change emergency semantics. But we need to codify header-based org overrides as a new precedence tier and add tests.
Sam: Telemetry request: emit route_applied=(org_override|global), override_id, matched_predicate, and target_pool in traces. Also mark span attribute org.override=true when applied.
infra-bot: HEADS UP: modifying routing precedence requires a config migration and a small DB schema change. Recommend staged rollout with feature flag.
Mike: Draft schema entry for console backend (single-line):
```
org_override: {
  org_id: "acme",
  predicate: {headers: {"X-ACME-PREF": "fast"}},
  priority: 90,
  target: "dedicated:acme-reserved",
  enforce_quotas: true
}
```
Sophie: UX note: show these under Org Settings -> Routing Overrides. Preview should be a one-line summary "Header X-ACME-PREF==fast -> acme-reserved" with expand for details + created_by/approved_by.
Ria: ACME explicitly said exact header match for now (no regex). They accept quotas. They also asked that the override be auditable in logs.
Sam: For audit logs, add fields override_id, created_by, approved_by, created_at, and a generated change log entry when rule is evaluated. Backfill existing rules with null approved_by flagged for review.
Mike: Can we gate creation of overrides behind entitlement? We must ensure customers can't route traffic to pools they don't own (no cross-tenant routing). Add allowlist of allowed target pools per org.
Sophie: Security asks manual approval for any target that references a pool outside the org's owned pools. We'll surface that in the UI modal with a checkbox and an approval button.
infra-bot: Plan for rollout: add feature flag `org-routing-headers-v1`, canary to 5 orgs, then 20, then global. Migration steps included in PR.
Sam: Tests: unit matcher precedence, integration test ensuring quotas still applied, e2e tracing for route_applied tag, console UI test for approval flow, and a small load test against routing table size.
Mike: Emergency control: add a cluster-scoped denylist toggle to globally disable all org overrides (admin-only endpoint). Also add rate limit cap per org to prevent cost spikes.
Ria: I'll coordinate with BizDev to add ACME to the canary list once PR is ready. Also they'll need to sign the spend waiver for demo.
Sophie: I'll draft the backend PR + Console wireframes. Will include approval modal mock and list view.
Sam: I'll own telemetry + backfill script and create migration ticket.
Mike: I'll implement the emergency denylist + add unit tests for precedence.
infra-bot: Reminder: any change touching routing must include docs update in /docs/routing and a short runbook for SREs.
Ria: Action items: Sophie (PR & UX), Sam (telemetry & migration), Mike (denylist + tests), Ria (canary coordination). Thanks!
:thumbsup:
